subject: summary.fitted.values: mismatch between outputs and number of sites

messages.author: 11f741253673c9e0
messages.subject: summary.fitted.values: mismatch between outputs and number of sites
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to pull out the summary fitted values(mean, 0.025,0.975) for all the locations in my dataset (2605) in-order to set informed prior distributions for each site's predicted effect into an occupancy model  (so we can propagate our uncertainty based on the inla model predictions). However, my model returns 5630 obs =! to the 2605 actual locations associated with the dataset . I'm unclear where the additional rows/points are coming from ~ is it related to my mesh? I've included my code below. thanks for any help/guidance.

#building mesh
prmesh2<-inla.mesh.2d(loc = coord.points, cutoff = 300, offset = c(1), 
                      max.edge = 300)

A <- inla.spde.make.A(prmesh2, loc=coord.points)

spde <- inla.spde2.matern(prmesh2, alpha=2) #matern spde object

stk.dat <- inla.stack(data=list(y=coord$PNTCNT),
                      A=list(A,1), tag='dat',
                      effects=list(list(i=1:spde$n.spde),
                                   data.frame(Intercept=1,
                                              groad=inla.group(coord$min_road),
                                              gvillage=inla.group(coord$min_FV), #village is of only importance
                                              griver=inla.group(coord$min_road))))

data<-inla.stack.data(stk.dat)

#building model
f.village <- y ~ 0 + Intercept + gvillage + f(i, model=spde)
f.village.1<- inla(f.village, family='nbinomial', 
                   control.compute=list(config=TRUE,dic=TRUE, waic=TRUE),
                   data=data,
                   control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stk.dat)))
                                          
#summary fitted values returns 5630 rows =!
coord$INLA<-f.village.1$summary.fitted.values[,"mean"] #mean
coord$INLAlow<-f.village.1$summary.fitted.values[,"0.025quant"] #lower limits
coord$INLAup<-f.village.1$summary.fitted.values[,"0.975quant"]  #upper limits

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] summary.fitted.values: mismatch between outputs and number of sites
parts:
You need to use inla.stack.index() to identify the indices that correspond to your sites.
Finn
